security_feature_bypassed: Entropy source repetition-count health-test boundary enforcement for the symbol-level REPCNTS path.
finding: The symbol-level repetition-count health test computes a threshold-met condition but then removes the equality case before producing the failure decision. In src/entropy_src/rtl/entropy_src_repcnts_ht.sv:86-88, threshold_met is rep_cntr >= thresh_i, threshold_equal is rep_cntr == thresh_i, and rep_cnt_fail is threshold_met && !threshold_equal. The resulting predicate is equivalent to rep_cntr > thresh_i. A repeated entropy symbol therefore does not produce test_fail_pulse_o when the repetition counter reaches the configured threshold; the failure is delayed until the next repeated symbol.

location_or_code_reference.proof_note: The proof bundle includes a directed single-DUT Verilator witness script and logs.

detection_method: The candidate was identified by CSBC, an LLM-driven RTL security analysis framework, and independently validated by directed single-DUT simulation. The proof drives repeated and alternating entropy symbols into entropy_src_repcnts_ht and observes the exported counter and failure pulse.
security_impact: A physical entropy-source fault or manipulation that produces a repeated symbol is reported one sample later than the configured threshold in the REPCNTS path. This weakens entropy health-test integrity at the exact configured boundary and can allow one additional repeated symbol to pass before the repetition-count failure pulse is raised.
proposed_mitigation: Drive rep_cnt_fail directly from threshold_met, or equivalently use rep_cnt_fail = (rep_cntr >= thresh_i).
Add a directed regression that sets a small REPCNTS threshold and checks that test_fail_pulse_o is asserted when test_cnt_o reaches that threshold.
Keep the alternating-symbol control to ensure the failure pulse remains specific to repeated-symbol behavior.
exploit_or_attack_flow: The entropy source is active and the REPCNTS threshold is configured.
The physical entropy input presents repeated identical symbols, as would happen for a stuck or manipulated symbol source.
The repetition counter reaches the configured threshold value.
Because equality is masked out of rep_cnt_fail, test_fail_pulse_o remains low at that boundary.
Only the next repeated symbol raises the failure pulse, so the health-test boundary is effectively threshold plus one.
